Home.heroTitle: Create <highlight>smarter quizzes</highlight> and improve with every attempt.
Home.heroSubtitle: Quizmify helps you generate quizzes in seconds, track your accuracy, review mistakes, and practice the concepts you actually need to improve.
Home.mockQuestion: How many hearts does an octopus have?
Home.featureAiBody: Generate relevant quiz questions instantly from any topic and start learning without wasting time preparing material.
Home.featureTrackBody: Measure your accuracy, review your answers, and understand where your weak spots are with clear statistics after every quiz.
Home.featureMistakesBody: Turn previous wrong answers into new learning opportunities and reinforce the topics that matter most.
Home.whyTitle: Learn with feedback, not just repetition.
Home.whyBody: Most quiz tools stop after showing the score. Quizmify goes further by helping you understand your performance, revisit your mistakes, and train smarter over time.
Home.ctaBody: Start generating quizzes, track your performance, and turn mistakes into progress with Quizmify.

q1.prompt: At a party where you don't know anyone...

options.q1_a: You go around introducing yourself, chatting with everyone
options.q1_b: You watch the room for a while before approaching anyone
options.q1_c: You stick close to your usual crew
options.q1_d: You find a quiet corner and let people come to you

q2.prompt: Your team's big project hits a snag...

options.q2_a: You take charge and organize the team
options.q2_b: You analyze the situation before proposing a fix
options.q2_d: You'd rather just handle your part alone

q3.prompt: A free weekend with no plans...

options.q3_a: You round up friends for whatever comes up
options.q3_b: You go explore something new, alone or with one close friend
options.q3_c: You organize something with your usual group
options.q3_d: You take the day for yourself, no agenda

q4.prompt: You're offered to lead a new project...

options.q4_a: You say yes right away — the challenge excites you
options.q4_b: You ask for time to think it over carefully
options.q4_c: You accept, as long as you can do it your way
options.q4_d: You accept if you can bring your own trusted team

options.q5_a: You step in and propose a direct solution
options.q5_b: You listen to both sides and help them understand each other
options.q5_c: You think it through before saying anything
options.q5_d: You'd rather stay out of it — let them sort it out

q6.prompt: At work or school, what motivates you most?

options.q6_d: Feeling like part of a solid team

q7.prompt: When something doesn't go as planned...

options.q7_a: You react fast and look for another angle
options.q7_b: You take a moment to understand what happened
options.q7_c: You lean on people close to you for support

q8.prompt: If you had to pick a superpower...

options.q8_a: Leading and protecting the people you care about
options.q8_b: Communicating with anyone, in any language
options.q8_c: Always spotting the solution no one else sees
options.q8_d: Turning invisible whenever you want to be alone

lion.name: Lion
lion.description: A natural leader — confident, decisive, and always ready to take charge. You protect the people around you and aren't afraid of a challenge.

dauphin.name: Dolphin
dauphin.description: Playful, social, and endlessly curious. You light up a room and connect with people effortlessly.

hibou.name: Owl
hibou.description: Thoughtful and observant. You'd rather understand something deeply than rush into it, and people trust your judgment.

renard.name: Fox
renard.description: Clever and adaptable. You find creative ways around problems that leave everyone else stuck.

loup.name: Wolf
loup.description: Loyal to the core. You're at your best working closely with a small circle you trust completely.

ours.name: Bear
ours.description: Calm and powerful, you move at your own pace and refuse to be rushed. Behind that easygoing exterior is a quiet strength the people close to you can always count on.

About.title: About Quizmify
About.intro: Discover how Quizmify is transforming the way people learn through AI-powered quiz generation and intelligent performance tracking.
About.descriptionEnglish: Quizmify is an AI-powered quiz platform that generates quizzes on any topic in seconds, tracks your performance, and turns your mistakes into practice opportunities.
About.descriptionSpanish: Quizmify es una plataforma de quizzes potenciada por IA que genera preguntas sobre cualquier tema en segundos, registra tu desempeño y convierte tus errores en oportunidades de práctica.
About.dataUsageDesc: Quizmify processes your quiz responses and learning data to personalize your experience and improve the platform. Your data is used for:
About.dataPoint1: Generating personalized quizzes tailored to your learning level and interests
About.dataPoint2: Tracking your performance metrics and progress over time
About.dataPoint3: Identifying topics where you need more practice and creating targeted review sessions
About.dataPoint4: Improving our AI models to deliver better quiz generation and recommendations
